sections.shortTitle: Registration Of Ships Act 1841 Amendment Act 1850
sections.description:
Passes under Act X of 1841 to ships of Acceding States wherever built

[THE (The word "Indian" omitted by A
[THE REGISTRATION OF SHIPS ACT (1841) AMENDMENT ACT, 1850.]
(The word "Indian" omitted by A.
O., 1949, Sch.)*
An Act to amend Act X of 1841
(See supra, on page 8.)
[15th March, 1850]
2. Passes under Act X of 1841 to ships of Acceding States wherever built.
The passes which, under section 24 of the said Act, may be issued for
conferring the privileges and advantages of a British ship, in certain cases,
to any ship or vessel built within (Certain original words have successively been subs. by A. O.,
1937 and the Federal Laws (Revision and Declaration) Act, 1951 (26 of 1951), s.
4 and III Sch., to read as above.)
[any Acceding State] may, after the passing of this Act, be issued in the like
cases, and under the same restrictions, to any ship or vessel belonging to any (Certain
original words have successively been subs. by A. O., 1937 and the Federal Laws
(Revision and Declaration) Act, 1951 (26 of 1951), s. 4 and III Sch., to read
as above.) [Acceding State or
the Ruler or a subject thereof] wherever the same may have been built.

sections.shortTitle: Registration Of Ships Act 1841 Amendment Act 1850
sections.description:
Registry of and passes to certain coasting vessels

[THE (The word "Indian" omitted by A
[THE REGISTRATION OF SHIPS ACT (1841) AMENDMENT ACT, 1850.]
(The word "Indian" omitted by A.
O., 1949, Sch.)*
An Act to amend Act X of 1841
(See supra, on page 8.)
[15th March, 1850]
3. Registry of and passes to certain coasting vessels. All ships or
vessels, of whatever and of whatever tonnage, owned by (Subs. by A. O., 1961, Art. 2 and Sch.
(with effect from the 23rd March, 1956), for "British subjects".) [citizens of Pakistan], entitled to
registry under (See supra, on page 8.)Act X of 1841, or owned by (Certain original words have successively been subs. by A. O.,
1937 and the Federal Laws (Revision and Declaration) Act, 1951 (26 of 1951), s.
4 and III Sch., to read as above.)
[an Acceding State or the Ruler or a subject thereof] entitled to passes under (See supra, on
page 8.)Act X of 1841, as
amended by this Act, employed only in coasting voyages, or between any port of (The words
"the Continent of" rep. by A. O., 1937.)* * * (Subs. by A. O., 1949, Sch., for "India and the Island of
Ceylon".) [Pakistan and
India, the Island of Ceylon] (Ins. by A. O., 1937.) [or Burma] may be registered and obtain passes, and the tonnage
may be marked, according to such rules as shall be made from time to time by (Subs. ibid.,
for "the Governor or G. in C. of each Presidency".) [Central Government].

sections.shortTitle: Registration Of Ships Act 1841 Amendment Act 1850
sections.description:
Fees for certificates of registry of such vessels

[THE (The word "Indian" omitted by A
[THE REGISTRATION OF SHIPS ACT (1841) AMENDMENT ACT, 1850.]
(The word "Indian" omitted by A.
O., 1949, Sch.)*
An Act to amend Act X of 1841
(See supra, on page 8.)
[15th March, 1850]
4. Fees for certificates of registry of such vessels. The owners of
coasting vessels, registered under section 3 of this Act, shall pay for each
certificate of registry‑
for a vessel not exceeding the
burthen of four tons, one rupee;
exceeding four tons and not
exceeding twenty tons, five rupees ;
exceeding twenty tons and not
exceeding eighty tons, seven rupees; exceeding eighty tons, for each ton two
annas ;
which fees shall (The original
words "be carried to the credit of the Government of the Presidency in
which they are levied" have successively been amended by A. O., 1937, and
A. O., 1961, Art. 2 and Sch. (with effect from the 23rd March, 1956), to read
as above.)[be carried to the
credit of the Central Govern ment].
